instruction: Change the title text color to red (RGB: 255, 0, 0) on slide 1.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing slide 1 title color to red (RGB: 255, 0, 0). Custom getter extracts the font color RGB values from the title text. Custom metric checks if the color matches the expected red with a tolerance of ±10 for each RGB component.
metadata.verification: Verified by reading the PowerPoint file: slide 1 has title 'Business Infographic Template '. Task asks to change color to red (255, 0, 0).

Getter has robust fallback mechanism (lines 49-64: finds title by position as topmost text shape if placeholder method fails).

Complete coverage: evaluator checks all requirements (title color = red RGB 255,0,0).
